description: Conversor DOI / arXiv / ISBN / PMID a BibTeX, con validación de archivos .bib — Reox Lab
name: bibrl

scripts.test: trap 'rm -f ./.tmp-test.mjs' EXIT; for f in tests/test-*.ts; do esbuild "$f" --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=./.tmp-test.mjs --log-level=error && node ./.tmp-test.mjs || exit 1; done
